title: Powers of the uniformizer are regular on completed coefficient sections
statement: Let ℓ be prime, E a finite extension of Q_ℓ, T any scheme and U any object of T_proet. For every m≥0, multiplication by the mth power of the constant uniformizer is injective on sections at U of the inverse-limit completed integral coefficient sheaf.

source.place: Coefficient sheaves and finite constant quotients, Tags 093J--093M; original item step 1 and the finite-level divisibility argument

proof.text: For a domain O and nonzero π, the finite map O/(π^r)→O/(π^(m+r)), [a]↦[π^m a], is injective by cancellation in the domain. Constant sheafification on sets, universe lifting, and evaluation preserve this injection.

source.place: Coefficient sheaves and finite constant quotients, Tags 093J--093M; original item step 1 and the finite-level divisibility argument

proof.text: For two compatible quotient families with equal products by π^m, evaluate at level m+r. Compatibility identifies the multiplied high-level projections with the images of their level-r projections under the preceding injection. Thus the level-r projections agree for all r.

source.place: Coefficient sheaves and finite constant quotients, Tags 093J--093M; original item step 1 and the finite-level divisibility argument

proof.text: The constant sheaf/underlying-set comparison identifies multiplication with the image of the finite multiplication map. Naturality of the constant-to-completed map identifies its scalar with the quotient uniformizer. The jointly injective inverse-limit projections prove equality of the original sections, including m=0 and empty U.

theorem completedIntegralScalar_regular
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E] (T : Scheme.{t})
    (m : ℕ) (U : T.ProEtᵒᵖ) :
    Function.Injective (fun x : (completedIntegralCoefficientSheafUnrestricted l E T).obj.obj U ↦
      ((integralConstantToCompletionOfUniverses l E T).hom.app U
        ((toSheafify (Scheme.ProEt.topology T)
          ((Functor.const T.ProEtᵒᵖ).obj
            (CommRingCat.of (ULift.{t + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E))))).app U
              (ULift.up (Padic.coefficientExtensionUniformizer l E)))) ^ m * x)
